extracted.name: Citrussy tofu udon shake-up salad
extracted.description: Liven up your packed lunch with this udon noodle-based salad, tossed with tofu, sugar snaps, pepper, spring onions and carrot in a lemon and lime dressing
ingredient_lines: 240g firm tofu patted dry then cut into cubes
instruction_lines: Put the tofu in a large bowl. Scatter over the cornflour and some salt and pepper. Mix well to coat. Heat the vegetable oil in a small frying pan on medium heat, then lower in the tofu and cook on all sides until golden, about 5-6 mins. Remove, then drain on kitchen paper and leave to cool.
In a large container, mix all the dressing ingredients together. Cook the udon following pack instructions.
Add the tofu to the container with the dressing, then top with the noodles, veg and the coriander, in that order, so the veg stays crunchy.
When you’re ready to serve, give it all a good shake to combine.
